notes.title: Update V1.0.4
notes.content:
[h1]Another![/h1]

[h1]1.0.4[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added helpful tips to the delivery scoring screen.
[*] Slightly improved car friction
[*] Made it so car loses speed more slowly when you are not pressing the gas

[*] Added Mouse Sensitivity Setting
[*] Fixed several bugs where settings were not updated until you paused the game.
[*] Adjusted settings tooltip hover area and improved some settings tooltips
[*] Adjusted unintuitive interactions between resolution and Fullscreen settings.
[/list]

We got another wave of feedback and noticed some common complaints, so we implemented some quick fixes. We are aware of some people's frustration with the feeling of the car, and have made some small changes, but are looking into more impactful solutions.

As always, you can reach us at our socials to report bugs or provide feedback.
glumpisgames@gmail.com
https://bsky.app/profile/glumpis.bsky.social
https://x.com/glumpisgames

[h2]Whit[/h2]

notes.title: Update V1.0.3
notes.content:
[h1]Yet another small Pizza Blitz update![/h1]

[h1]1.0.3[/h1]

[list]
[*] Rats no longer moonwalk after returning from the delivery scene
[*] Rats no longer block interacting with nearby objects in certain situations
[*] Rats can no longer spawn inside the pizza making counter
[*] Drinks removed from the six pack item now properly sync with safe content settings
[*] Car Turbo Visual now fades/in and out instead of cutting abruptly on/off.
[/list]

This should cover the bulk of our planned updates for Pizza Blitz this month. We still have a few small things on the list, but are currently regarding them as low priority.

Again, if you have any questions, bugs to report, feedback or anything else, please feel free to reach out to us on any of our socials or our email.

https://x.com/glumpisgames

https://bsky.app/profile/glumpis.bsky.social

glumpisgames@gmail.com


Whit

notes.title: First Patch & Upcoming Updates.
notes.content:
Hello,

First I just wanted to thank everybody that has bought the game and I hope that you are enjoying it. 
We expected to make like 20 bucks on this game, and even if its mostly from people we know and have coerced into buying our stupid little game, we are really happy to say we can happily buy like, 100 bucks worth of pizza. Yippee!

Our first patch, v1.0.1, released along side this announcement, includes the following:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Failing Successfully achievement wasn't getting set properly
[*] Fixed an issue where score would persist between runs
[*] Adjusted stray bullets in the delivery section of the game (there's now a much less chance you get hit by one)
[*] Reworded the "More-Overachiever" achievement 
[*] Fixed some objects that did not have collision in the delivery scene
[/list]

Additionally, we have started to work on addressing a number of other small bugs we discovered post launch as well as some of the feedback we have received from friends and family. We are currently planning to group these together as several small patches/hotfixes to try to get things out sooner rather than later. 

We do not have a concrete timeline as we are taking the time post launch to relax a little and deal with some major life changes IRL, but we are hoping to complete the following before the end of February. 

Bugs we are working on:
[list]
[*] Rats will block interaction with nearby objects after they have been pushed by a wind source. If you are having issues consistently interacting with things in the pizzeria, this is most likely why.
[*] Six Packs purchased from the shop are not properly synced with safe content settings. (causes root beer to appear even if safe content is off)
[*] Rats can get stuck inside the main pizza making counter.
[*] Darts will be placed on the incorrect camera rendering layer in some cases, causing them to appear in front of all objects.
[*] Rat moonwalking, and other Rat AI issues
[/list]

Feedback we are currently working to address:
[list]
[*] Improve Car Turbo VFX (just for Violet)
[*] making Rat SFX less annoying
[/list]

There are more bugs and feedback we have plans to address in the future, however we do not expect those to get done in the February updates. 

If you have any bugs or feedback you'd like to tell us about, you can shoot us an email at glumpisgames@gmail.com


Thanks for reading,
 Whit.

notes.title: Pizza Blitz out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Pizza Blitz has officially released![/h1]

This marks the release of our first indie game as Glumpis Games! We are excited for people to finally play our first game, and to let us know what you think of it!

Pizza Blitz originally started as a Game Jam for Brackeys Game Jam 2024.2, and ever since the feedback we received when the jam was finished, we decided we should update the game and bring it to Steam.

This is a big deal for us, our first indie game ever published, and would love to hear all feedback. Whether you love it or you hate it, we wanna hear about it, so we can do better for the future and work on making an even better game next time.

We sincerely hope that you enjoy Pizza Blitz! We will monitor the game post launch and try to release bug fixes or updates as needed. 

We also hope that if you like Pizza Blitz, you'll stay with us until our next game comes out. Whatever that may be. 

Thank you for playing, and for reading this post!

- Glumpis Games
